info.title: API.SH: About You
info.description: The About You API from API.SH: public About You data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
ABOUT YOU brands: one brand by id (name, slug, logo, link) or the full brand list page by page (100 per page). Products of a brand: /aboutyou/v1/search with brand=<id>. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aboutyou-brands

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A brand id, e.g. 364.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the brand list (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Brands per page (default and max 100).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, currency and language follow it): DE, AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, IT, ES, PT, IE, PL, CZ, SK, HU, RO, SI, HR, BG, GR, SE, DK, FI, EE, LV, LT. Default DE.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The ABOUT YOU category tree of a country shop (Women, Men, Kids and their sub-categories) or one category with its children: id, name, slug, path, parent, depth, link and the filters the category supports. Category ids work as `category` on the search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aboutyou-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id: returns that category and its children. Without it, the tree from the top.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels below the top or the given category (default 2 from the top, 1 for an id, max 3).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, currency and language follow it): DE, AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, IT, ES, PT, IE, PL, CZ, SK, HU, RO, SI, HR, BG, GR, SE, DK, FI, EE, LV, LT. Default DE.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: local (default) or en (English labels; DE, AT, CH and NL only).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ABOUT YOU filters for a search
get.description:
Every filter facet ABOUT YOU offers for a keyword search or category, with value ids, names and product counts (brands, colours, sizes, materials, patterns, the category's own facets, price range, savings range, sale and new). Use the `param` and value ids as filters on /aboutyou/v1/search. Other filters may be passed here too to narrow the counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aboutyou-filters

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Either q or category is required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id, e.g. 20218.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, currency and language follow it): DE, AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, IT, ES, PT, IE, PL, CZ, SK, HU, RO, SI, HR, BG, GR, SE, DK, FI, EE, LV, LT. Default DE.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: local (default) or en (English labels; DE, AT, CH and NL only).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aboutyou-product

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: local (default) or en (English labels; DE, AT, CH and NL only).

get.description:
Search ABOUT YOU products by keywords or category in any of its 26 country shops, with every filter the shop offers: any facet from /aboutyou/v1/filters as a param named by its slug with value ids (brand, color, categoryShopFilterSizes, materialStyle, pattern and the category's own facets, comma list = any of), price range, sale and new, in six sort orders. Each product: id, name, brand and brand id, colour, gender, product type, price, price before sale, recommended retail price, applied reductions, price range across sizes, currency, sold out and new flags, first live date, images and link, plus `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aboutyou-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Either q or category is required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (the number at the end of an aboutyou.<tld>/c/... link, e.g. 20218 for belts). A category link in url= works too.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, currency and language follow it): DE, AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, IT, ES, PT, IE, PL, CZ, SK, HU, RO, SI, HR, BG, GR, SE, DK, FI, EE, LV, LT. Default DE.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: local (default) or en (English labels; DE, AT, CH and NL only).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand id(s), comma list (ids from /aboutyou/v1/filters or /aboutyou/v1/brands).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour value id(s), comma list (from /aboutyou/v1/filters).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: sale
parameters.description: true = reduced items only, false = full price only.

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: true = new arrivals only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (default 40, max 100).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
